policy.oversize_detector_boxes: area > v0.2 candidate_max_area_raw_px: never merged with other candidates; kept as their own records, ordered last

states_rule.VLM_ACCEPTED: stored/new Qwen crop answer is yes
states_rule.PROBABLE: Qwen says no, but >= 2 source types point at the box AND Qwen itself reports the target colour (disagreement is recorded)
states_rule.REJECTED: Qwen says no and the PROBABLE condition does not hold
states_rule.PENDING_VERIFICATION: no Qwen answer exists for this candidate
states_rule.AMBIGUOUS: photo-level decision when more than one candidate is VLM_ACCEPTED or PROBABLE; none is chosen automatically
states_rule.use_of_PROBABLE: virtual task planning only; never counted as a pick-up or detection success
